evals.prompt: Audite este arquivo HTML/CSS com a skill frontend-ui-ux-auditor verificando tokens OKLCH e escala de 8px, propriedades lógicas e colapso de margem, contraste WCAG 2.1 AA, profundidade DOM, Navegação em 3 Camadas (Breadcrumbs), ícones 1:1, iluminação zenital, sombras em 3 níveis, @container e transições sem reflow.
expected_assertions: Runs scripts/ui_ux_frontend_auditor.py and computes weighted Score_UI/UX across all 6 dimensions (Tokens 20%, Typography/WCAG 20%, Box/DOM/Nav 15%, Iconography 15%, Zenith Light/Shadows 15%, @container/Motion 15%)
Computes W3C relative luminance and contrast ratio CR = (L_lighter + 0.05) / (L_darker + 0.05) requiring >= 4.5:1
Flags off-scale arbitrary spacing (p-[13px], margin: 11px), divsoup_ratio > 0.45, missing multi-layer shadows (--shadow-elevation-1..3), and reflow animations (width/height/margin)

evals.prompt: Run ui_ux_frontend_auditor.py to inspect DOM depth, divsoup ratio, 90-120 zenithal light catch-light, and WCAG AA contrast across our CSS stylesheets.
expected_assertions: Executes ui_ux_frontend_auditor.py --target with --json output and evaluates max_dom_depth <= 12 and divsoup_ratio <= 0.45
Audits --catch-light (inset 0 1px 0 0) and 3-level elevation tokens without editing source files

evals.prompt: Refactor my React Dashboard and implement a new polymorphic SurfaceCard component with Tailwind v4 and Next.js App Router.
expected_assertions: Does not trigger frontend-ui-ux-auditor (read-only visual auditor) for implementing or refactoring UI code; routes to frontend-code-architect

evals.prompt: Otimize esta query SQL no BigQuery e limpe arquivos duplicados no Google Drive.
expected_assertions: Does not trigger frontend-ui-ux-auditor for BigQuery SQL optimization or Google Drive cleanup
